page0.text:
It's past seven.
Fuji-nee already left for school, and we're cleaning up.
Sakura doesn't need to rush today, so we take our time doing the dishes together.

page1.text:
Morning clean-up goes by in a flash since we're both helping each other out.
...I find myself checking on Sakura, but she looks like she's feeling better.
It seems like her fever is gone, and she's full of energy.

page2.text:
"Um, Senpai...!
M-might I have a moment of your time to talk!?"

page3.text:
She suddenly blurts out a question,
like it's now or never.

page4.text:
"You certainly might. We still have plenty of time.
"R-right. Well...um...I tried making lunch for you."
Sakura hands me a lunchbox.

page5.text:
It's different from the one I sometimes use. She must have prepared it herself.
Unlike my boring lunchbox, it has a cute shape and it's even wrapped in a pleasantly-colored cloth.
I'm grateful, and I can count on it tasting good if Sakura made it.

page6.text:
"Mm, thanks... Wait, did you wake up early today just to make this?"
By the time I came to the living room this morning, Sakura was already finished making breakfast.
I was impressed at how early she must have gotten up, but it seems that she's even more of an early riser than I thought.

page7.text:
"Yes. I woke up early and didn't have anything else to do, so I thought I'd make you lunch...and, I'd like to ask for your advice."
"? What's up? Sounds important."

page8.text:
"N-no, not really...!
I don't think so, anyway...but, yeah! I don't see you make lunch to bring to school very often. Why is that, when you like cooking so much?"
"...Sakura, I don't particularly enjoy cooking, you know."

page9.text:
Plus, cooking isn't supposed to be a hobby that guys have. I just happen to be able to do it, and I'd like to leave it at that.
Anyway, she wants to know why I don't make my own lunch, right...

page10.text: "I know that it would save money to bring my own lunch, but it makes all the guys in class flock to my desk. Before I know it, half my food is gone."

page11.text:
Sakura nods slowly.
...It's actually the girls in class who tend to take most of my food, but I decide not to mention it because it makes me sound pathetic.

page12.text: "Yeah, so that's why I only make lunch on the days I can eat in the student council office. When I'm there, I can eat in private with Issei."

page13.text:
"...U-um, Senpai? What about having lunch at the range?
The club building's open during the day, you can make tea there, and, um, it's quiet and there's nobody around, so..."

page14.text:
?
Oh, I never considered that.
The archery range is unlocked during daytime, and even club members are unlikely to stop by.
Only Mitsuzuri's likely to be around, if at all, and she isn't rude enough to lay hands on another person's lunch.

page15.text:
"...Okay. Yeah, I think that could work."
"R-right!
Th-that's an obvious option, isn't it!?"
"I'm an outsider, though. I'd better get Mitsuzuri's permission first."

page16.text:
"N-no, you'll be fine! It's a school building, and I'm pretty sure students can come and go as they please even outside of club activities!"
Sakura's being unusually forceful.

page17.text:
"Hmm...well, all right. As long as I'm not imposing on anyone."
I accept the proposal.
And for some reason,
Sakura looks utterly ecstatic, even pumping her fist.

page18.text:
"...?"
Hmm...maybe Fuji-nee's good mood rubbed off on her.
